units.source_text: 太吉郎打年轻时起就有名士气质，而且比较孤僻。

en.t: From the time he was young, Takichiro had the air of a distinguished man, and he was also rather solitary.

units.source_text: 他完全没有要举办个人染织作品展览的雄心。

en.t: He had absolutely no ambition to hold a solo exhibition of his dyed and woven works.

units.source_text: 就算举办了，在那个时候，恐怕也会过于新奇而难以卖出去。

en.t: Even if he had held one, in those days it would probably have been too novel and hard to sell.
